note: Generic moves are listed once under a plain name; characters learn them under their own anime names. Signature moves belong to one character form.

moves.name: Quick Attack
moves.effect: Goes first.

moves.name: Arm Thrust
moves.effect: Hits 2–5 times in a row.

moves.name: Headbutt
moves.effect: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Extreme Speed
moves.effect: Goes first, even before most other quick moves.

moves.name: Super Fang
moves.effect: Halves the target's current Vitality.

moves.name: Counter
moves.effect: Goes last. Hits back for double the Physical damage the user took this turn.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.effect: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.effect: Lowers the user's Guard and Will by 1.

moves.name: Protect
moves.effect: Blocks every move aimed at the user this turn. Likely to fail if used twice in a row.

moves.name: Endure
moves.effect: The user survives any hit this turn with at least 1 Vitality. Likely to fail if used twice in a row.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.effect: Spends 1/4 of max Vitality on a decoy that takes hits for the user.

moves.name: Swords Dance
moves.effect: Raises the user's Power by 2.

moves.name: Nasty Plot
moves.effect: Raises the user's Energy by 2.

moves.name: Recover
moves.effect: Heals half the user's max Vitality.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.effect: Duos: the ally's move this turn does 1.5x damage.

moves.name: Follow Me
moves.effect: Duos: foes' single-target moves hit the user this turn.

moves.name: Encore
moves.effect: The target must repeat its last move for 3 turns.

moves.name: Roar
moves.effect: Goes last. Forces the target to switch to a random ally. Ends a wild battle.

moves.name: Aqua Jet
moves.effect: Goes first.

moves.name: Whirlpool
moves.effect: Traps the target for 4–5 turns and takes 1/8 of its max Vitality each turn.

moves.name: Razor Shell
moves.effect: 50% chance to lower the target's Guard by 1.

moves.name: Waterfall
moves.effect: 20% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Aqua Step
moves.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 1.

moves.name: Crabhammer
moves.effect: High chance of a critical hit.

moves.name: Flame Charge
moves.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 1.

moves.name: Flame Wheel
moves.effect: 10% chance to Burn.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.effect: 10% chance to Burn.

moves.name: Fire Lash
moves.effect: Lowers the target's Guard by 1.

moves.name: Sacred Fire
moves.effect: 50% chance to Burn.

moves.name: Flare Blitz
moves.effect: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil. 10% chance to Burn.

moves.name: Aerial Ace
moves.effect: Never misses.

moves.name: U-turn
moves.effect: The user switches out after hitting.

moves.name: Air Slash
moves.effect: 30% chance to make the target flinch.

moves.name: Fly
moves.effect: Rises out of reach on the first turn, hits on the second.

moves.name: Brave Bird
moves.effect: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt as recoil.

moves.name: Stored Power
moves.effect: Power rises by 20 for every stat boost the user has.

moves.name: Shift Gear
moves.effect: Raises the user's Speed by 2 and Power by 1.

moves.name: Night Slash
moves.effect: High chance of a critical hit.

moves.name: Sucker Punch
moves.effect: Goes first. Fails unless the target is about to attack.

moves.name: Foul Play
moves.effect: Uses the target's Power instead of the user's.

moves.name: Thunder Wave
moves.effect: Stuns the target.

moves.name: Volt Switch
moves.effect: The user switches out after hitting.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.effect: 10% chance to Stun.

moves.name: Shadow Ball
moves.effect: 20% chance to lower the target's Will by 1.

moves.name: Wish
moves.effect: Next turn, whoever is in the user's place heals half the user's max Vitality.

moves.name: Light Screen
moves.effect: Halves Energy damage to the user's team for 5 turns.

moves.name: Heal Bell
moves.effect: Cures the status of every character on the user's team.

moves.name: Dazzling Gleam
moves.effect: Duos: hits both foes.

moves.name: Play Rough
moves.effect: 10% chance to lower the target's Power by 1.

moves.name: Sticky Web
moves.effect: Hazard: every foe that switches in loses 1 Speed. Stays until removed.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.effect: Lowers the target's Speed by 1.

moves.name: Bulldoze
moves.effect: Hits everyone else on the field and lowers their Speed by 1.

moves.name: Howl
moves.effect: Raises the Power of the user and its ally by 1.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.effect: Raises the user's Power and Guard by 1.

moves.name: Lunge
moves.effect: Lowers the target's Power by 1.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.effect: Goes last. The user switches out.

moves.name: Cosmic Power
moves.effect: Raises the user's Guard and Will by 1.

moves.name: Psychic Terrain
moves.effect: Field for 5 turns: Cosmic moves do 1.3x, and quick (priority) moves can't hit anyone on the field.

moves.name: Psyshock
moves.effect: Damage is worked out against the target's Guard instead of its Will.

moves.name: Spacial Rend
moves.effect: High chance of a critical hit.

moves.name: Water Breathing, Tenth Form: Constant Flux
moves.effect: Power rises by 50 each turn it is used in a row, up to 200. Resets if the user switches out or uses another move.
moves.source: The water dragon that grows stronger with every rotation, used against Rui.

moves.name: Hinokami Kagura: Dance
moves.effect: Hits as Fire and Water at once (both type matchups count). The user loses 1/8 of its max Vitality.
moves.source: Mixing Water Breathing with his father's fire dance against Rui. The dance wears his body out.

moves.name: Sun Breathing, Thirteenth Form
moves.effect: The user attacks for 2–3 turns in a row and can't switch, then becomes Confused from exhaustion.
moves.source: Chaining all twelve forms in an endless loop to hold Muzan until sunrise.

moves.name: Detroit Smash
moves.effect: Lowers the user's Power by 2.
moves.source: His first 100% punch, against the Zero Pointer and the Nomu. It breaks his arm every time.

moves.name: One For All: Full Cowl
moves.effect: Raises the user's Power and Speed by 1. For the rest of the battle the user takes no recoil.
moves.source: Spreading One For All through his whole body so it stops breaking his bones.

moves.name: Blackwhip
moves.effect: The target can't switch out and loses 1/8 of its max Vitality each turn for 4–5 turns. The user can still switch.
moves.source: The fifth user's quirk, which he uses to tie down villains as a vigilante.

moves.name: Behind the Scenes
moves.effect: The user switches out. The ally that comes in gets +1 Power and +1 Energy.
moves.source: Pulling the strings while Horikita and others take the credit.

moves.name: Rooftop Showdown
moves.effect: Removes all of the target's stat boosts before it hits.
moves.source: Taking Ryuen apart on the rooftop once he finally drops the act.

moves.name: White Room Masterpiece
moves.effect: Ignores the target's ability and stat changes.
moves.source: The White Room's perfect product, who reads and answers anything.

moves.name: Shadow Motion
moves.effect: Goes first, even before most other quick moves.
moves.source: Stepping through shadows like the Tempest Wolves, which Gobta picks up faster than anyone expected.

moves.name: Grape Rush
moves.effect: Hits 2–5 times in a row, then lowers the target's Speed by 1.
moves.source: His barrage of sticky balls, thrown until his scalp bleeds.

moves.name: Hisagomaru
moves.effect: Heals the user or an ally by half its max Vitality and cures its status.
moves.source: His zanpakuto, which heals by soaking up wounds.

moves.name: Justice Crash
moves.effect: Power is higher the lower the user's Vitality: 20 at full, up to 200 when nearly down.
moves.source: His battle cry as he charges the Deep Sea King knowing he will lose.

moves.name: Narukami
moves.effect: Never misses. 30% chance to Stun.

moves.name: Godspeed: Whirlwind
moves.effect: Goes first, even before most other quick moves. Fails unless the target is about to attack.
moves.source: Godspeed's automatic mode, his body reacting to an attack before he thinks.

moves.name: Gomu Gomu no Bazooka
moves.effect: Forces the target to switch to a random ally. Ends a wild battle.
moves.source: The two-palm blast that sends enemies flying off the screen.

moves.name: Gomu Gomu no King Kong Gun
moves.effect: Lowers the user's Power and Guard by 1.
moves.source: Gear 4's giant fist against Doflamingo. Gear 4 leaves him drained once it runs out.

moves.name: Gomu Gomu no Bajrang Gun
moves.effect: The user must rest on the next turn.
moves.source: Gear 5's island-sized fist that ends the fight with Kaido.

moves.name: Hollow Technique: Purple
moves.effect: Lowers the user's Energy by 2.
moves.source: Merging Blue and Red into the imaginary mass that erases everything in its path.
